name: reference_digest
description: Canonical reference-sample digest (io/digest.py) the stats were computed from.

name: run_id
description: Pipeline run that computed/persisted this row.

name: generation_plan
description: Engine routing label (constant|numeric|categorical|temporal|shaped_identifier|freetext_llm_pool) when known at compute time.

name: empty_fraction
description: Fraction of sampled rows whose value is a trimmed-empty string.

name: distinct
description: Distinct non-empty, non-null values in the sample.

name: stats
description: Full per-column stats entry as JSON (source of truth for fields not broken out).

name: sample_rows
description: Rows the fractions were computed over: reference-sample size (tier=sample) or full-table count (tier=exact). Without it distinct_ratio is not comparable across runs with different --reference-limit.

name: stats_tier
description: sample = computed from the eager reference sample (distinct is sample-bound); exact = merged with the one-scan full-table aggregate pass (--source_stats=exact).

name: profiler_version
description: profile_source_table version; part of the append-skip key so profiler upgrades re-write stats for an unchanged reference_digest.
